mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_login_history ( tenant_id, login_account_id, authority_id, user_id, login_code, authority_code, user_code, user_name, login_dt, login_ip, login_type, user_agent, login_result, fail_reason ) VALUES ( COALESCE( (SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1), (SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = 'PLATFORM' LIMIT 1) ), ( SELECT la.login_account_id FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = la.tenant_id WHERE la.login_code = #{userId} AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT a.authority_id FROM tb_authority a WHERE a.authority_code = COALESCE(#{authorityCode}, 'UNKNOWN') LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT la.user_id FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = la.tenant_id WHERE la.login_code = #{userId} AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 ), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{userId}, ''), 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{authorityCode}, ''), 'UNKNOWN'), ( SELECT u.user_code FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = la.tenant_id JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = la.user_id WHERE la.login_code = #{userId} AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 ), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{userName}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{userId}, ''), 'UNKNOWN')), now(), #{loginIp}, #{loginType}, #{userAgent}, #{loginResult}, #{failReason} )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_login_history lh JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = lh.tenant_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
AND lh.login_code ILIKE '%' || #{searchUserId} || '%'
AND lh.user_name ILIKE '%' || #{searchUserName} || '%'
AND lh.login_result = #{searchLoginResult}
AND lh.login_dt >= #{searchStartDt}::timestamp
AND lh.login_dt <= (#{searchEndDt}::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 day')

SELECT lh.login_history_id, t.tenant_code AS factory_code, lh.login_code AS user_id, lh.user_name, to_char(lh.login_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_dt, lh.login_ip, lh.login_type, lh.user_agent, lh.authority_code, lh.login_result, lh.fail_reason, to_char(lh.logout_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS logout_dt, lh.session_time, NULL::varchar AS gov_interface_yn, NULL::varchar AS gov_interface_dt, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt_cd, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt_dtl, NULL::varchar AS gov_fail_reason, NULL::text AS gov_request_json, NULL::text AS gov_response_json FROM tb_login_history lh JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = lh.tenant_id WHERE lh.login_history_id = #{loginHistoryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_login_history SET logout_dt = now(), session_time = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - login_dt))::integer / 60 WHERE login_history_id = #{loginHistoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT lh.login_history_id, t.tenant_code AS factory_code, lh.login_code AS user_id, lh.user_name, to_char(lh.login_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_dt, lh.login_ip, lh.login_type, lh.user_agent, lh.authority_code, lh.login_result, lh.fail_reason, to_char(lh.logout_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS logout_dt, lh.session_time, NULL::varchar AS gov_interface_yn, NULL::varchar AS gov_interface_dt, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt_cd, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt_dtl, NULL::varchar AS gov_fail_reason, NULL::text AS gov_request_json, NULL::text AS gov_response_json FROM tb_login_history lh JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = lh.tenant_id ORDER BY login_dt DESC, login_history_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT lh.login_history_id, t.tenant_code AS factory_code, lh.login_code AS user_id, lh.user_name, to_char(lh.login_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_dt, lh.login_ip, lh.login_type, lh.user_agent, lh.authority_code, lh.login_result, lh.fail_reason, to_char(lh.logout_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS logout_dt, lh.session_time, NULL::varchar AS gov_interface_yn, NULL::varchar AS gov_interface_dt, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt_cd, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt, NULL::varchar AS gov_recptn_rslt_dtl, NULL::varchar AS gov_fail_reason, NULL::text AS gov_request_json, NULL::text AS gov_response_json FROM tb_login_history lh JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = lh.tenant_id WHERE ( DATE(lh.login_dt) >= #{fromDate}::date AND DATE(lh.login_dt) <= #{toDate}::date ) ORDER BY login_dt DESC, login_history_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_login_history SET gov_interface_yn = #{govInterfaceYn}, gov_interface_dt = now(), gov_recptn_rslt_cd = #{govRecptnRsltCd}, gov_recptn_rslt = #{govRecptnRslt}, gov_recptn_rslt_dtl = #{govRecptnRsltDtl}, gov_fail_reason = #{govFailReason}, gov_request_json = #{govRequestJson}, gov_response_json = #{govResponseJson} WHERE login_history_id = #{loginHistoryId}
